title: Wealth Tax Simulator
header_description: Estimate annual wealth taxes for different regions. Pick a model (Zurich / Mallorca), enter total personal wealth, and see the estimated annual tax (absolute and as % of wealth).
invalid_wealth: Please enter a valid wealth amount (>= 0).
about_models_text: The site includes two region-specific example models implemented from official sources (see SOURCES.md). Mallorca implements the 2024 autonomous-region exemption and bracket scale. Zurich implements the cantonal progressive tariff and applies municipality multipliers for final tax.
